today.theme: Invite every voice into a meeting
today.source: Harvard Business Review IdeaCast — Why Your Team Won’t Speak Up (And How to Fix It)
today.listen_task: First pass: identify the three kinds of conversation the host describes. With the transcript, notice how a practical issue can also signal an emotional concern, and listen for the cue that tells a leader to respond with empathy before problem-solving.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, open a meeting about a risky deadline: invite a quieter colleague to share a concern, say you want to understand it before deciding, and name the next step the group will take.

phrases.phrase: Can we make space for concerns before we decide?
phrases.note: Invite candid input without delaying the whole meeting indefinitely.

phrases.phrase: I want to make sure we hear every perspective.
phrases.note: Signal that participation, not just speed, matters in a group discussion.

phrases.phrase: What feels most important to raise?
phrases.note: Ask an open question that gives a colleague room to name a risk or need.
